name: clearcare
description: A private health record and AI insight system for one person: appointments, medications, diagnoses, tests, check-ins, and a Claude chat that connects symptoms to the record.

scripts.start: npm run build -w @clearcare/web && PORT=8090 tsx apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p scripts
